text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1153, 6 Inch Blue Crab Door Knocker in Nickel Silver Finish

The Large Nickel Silver Crab Door Knocker is great for adding a vacation home feel to any door, both on the Eastern Seaboard and those that are a little more land locked. This Premium Nickel Silver Blue Crab Door Knocker is big, measuring 6 inches tall and 7 inches wide, so it will be sure to stand out even on large doors. The Nickel Silver Finish is unique to Michael Healy Designs; it is created by combining polished nickel with satin highlights that accent this front door knocker's details for a contemporary look. This Blue Crab Front Door Knocker has 1-3/8 inch mounting centers and comes packaged with all the necessary installation hardware.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Nickel Silver Polished Brass and Brown Patina Oiled Bronze

Features and Specifications of the Blue Crab Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Nickel Silver
  • Height: 6"
  • Width: 7"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 1-3/8"
  • Projection Off Door: 2-1/4"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
